test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Central Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2022, is related to establishment of the ______________ .

options.text: Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh (CTUAP)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya:-**

 
 
• It is a newly created Central University, located in Vadodara, Gujarat, India.
 
• **It was established in 2018 as a Deemed to be University under De Novo Category, and was later converted into a Central University on December 6, 2022, vide Central Universities (Amendment) Act 2022. **
 
• The University offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in the following areas:
 
 
• **Transportation Engineering**
 
• **Rail Transport**
 
• **Road Transport**
 
• **Air Transport**
 
• **Logistics**
 
• **Supply Chain Management**
 
• **Infrastructure Management**
 
 
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh:-**

 
 
• **CTUAP is a central university located in Marrivalasa, Vizianagaram district, Andhra Pradesh, India. **
 
• It is a fully funded by the Central Government through the University Grants Commission (UGC).
 
• The university offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various disciplines, including tribal studies, tribal art, literature, and culture.
 
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi Central University:-**
 
 
• **MGCU is a central university located in Motihari, India. **
 
• It is named after Mahatma Gandhi, the father of the Indian nation.
 
• The university was established by an Act of Parliament in 2014 and became functional in 2016.
 
• MGCU offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various disciplines, including humanities, social sciences, sciences, and technology.
 
 
 
• **Central University of Andhra Pradesh:-**
 
 
• **CUAP is a central university located in Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh, India. **
 
• It is one of the 44 central universities established in India by an Act of Parliament in 2018.
 
• CUAP offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in various disciplines, including science, technology, humanities, management, and social sciences.
